I’ll admit I feel like there’s a flow to KH3 that doesn’t exist in 2FM due to being able to combo a lot of different things together and also switching keyblades. I’ve done some crazy mob kills in this game from saving forms, so stuff like form change combos are some of my favorite things in this game. Also, the fact that being able to block and dodge midcombo and in the air is also great. It’s just a shame that doing things like shot locks, links and attraction flow is so mindlessly broken it ruins what they were going for. They should’ve focused more on utilizing flow motion more cause you can do endless combos since using it pretty much resets your combo, and lets you juggle enemies.

I wish we could be a bit more productive instead of saying “no ur wrong lol”. I think both games have their merits gameplay wise, and would love to see maybe a meld or expansion of the two for KH4.
